params.rationale: The focus need 'need-water-main' at building b5 requires 600L of water. Available stock from org0 (r-org0-water) is 600L, but the floor is 100L, leaving 500L available. Using two vehicles (v-org0-1 and v-org0-0) with a capacity of 300L each, we can deliver 500L of the requested 600L.
